purpose.summary: Logo files for Weather Together, ready to use on the web, in documents, and in QR codes.
goals: Use the supplied logo files so Weather Together looks the same everywhere.
Give staff and partners a logo with and without the tagline.

generalRules: Use the supplied artwork. Do not recolor, stretch, or redraw the logo.
Leave clear space around the logo and do not overlap it with other graphics.

variants.name: Logo
variants.description: Three waves above WEATHER in black and TOGETHER in blue.
variants.usage: Use in most documents, slides, and web pages.

variants.name: Logo with tagline
variants.description: The same logo with the tagline Prepare Today. Protect Tomorrow. below.
variants.usage: Use when there is room for the tagline.

qrCodeLogos.guidance: The default is the logo, centered on a white square. Use it for the center of a QR code.

items.name: QR code logo
items.description: Weather Together logo on a white square.
items.usage: Use as the logo in the center of a QR code for Weather Together.

guidance.primaryPalette: Black and blue are the two colors in the logo.
guidance.secondaryPalette: No other colors have been provided.
guidance.continuity: These colors were taken from the logo artwork, not from a style guide. Use the supplied logo files rather than re-creating them from these values.

guidance: No typography guidance has been provided for this brand yet.

fileFormats.masterArtworkRule: Use the supplied files as they are. Do not recolor, stretch, or redraw them.

print.description: Only PNG files are available right now. Ask for a vector file before printing at very large sizes.

webElectronic.description: Use the PNG files on white or light backgrounds.

publicationNotes: The logos were supplied as image files with white backgrounds. A transparent version has not been made.
Colors were sampled from the logo image and are approximate.
No style guide, owner, or website has been provided for this brand yet.
